title: Training corpus of spoken Slovenian ROG (ROG-Art)
why_promising: ROG-Art contributes genuinely new manual prosodic-unit, disfluency, and dialogue-act annotations over pre-existing Slovenian speech and aligns those layers to audio/transcriptions. The public CLARIN.SI deposit is CC BY-SA 4.0 and exposes a 22.24 MB ROG.zip with EXMARaLDA EXB/EXS, TRS, Praat TextGrid files with additional prosodic annotations, speaker/recording metadata, and 39,001 words in 1,969 sentences; a separate 1.31 GB WAV archive is available. This meets the exception for secondary recordings when new human annotations are isolable and is useful for prosodic/temporal production structure.
open_question: Ingest only the genuinely new ROG-Art human annotation layers, not inherited GOS/SST material as if newly annotated. Direct ZIP retrieval was not available through the current fetch path, so next pass should obtain ROG.zip from the authoritative CLARIN bitstream, enumerate every EXB/EXS/TextGrid/TRS/metadata file, identify exact prosodic tier semantics and timing units, and link to the underlying GOS recording lineage without duplicating recordings.
